subject: Strategic requisition triage + temporary offer hold (comp bands review)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Strategic requisition triage + temporary offer hold (comp bands review)

Team —

Quick heads-up: given the Q2 spend review and a few upcoming vendor renewals, I recommend a short, targeted pause on new hiring activity while we triage open requisitions and validate comp band alignment.

Proposal (timing: 72 hours to stand up a decision slate):
- Immediately pause outbound offers for non-critical IC roles and freeze new req approvals.
- Run a 1-pager triage for each open req (impact, time-to-hire, replacement vs. net new). I attached the current open_reqs_inventory_20260528.csv.
- People Ops to run a comp-band sanity check for any offer > 85th percentile vs. our Q2 bands (comp_bands_q2_2026.xlsx attached).
- Exceptions: critical roles (SRE emergency scale, safety, or active revenue-impacting hires) can be fast-tracked with VP sign-off.

Please confirm: do we lock offers out system-wide, or allow recruiters to continue negotiations until an offer is signed? I want a tight default but pragmatic exception flow.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: open_reqs_inventory_20260528.csv (stub), comp_bands_q2_2026.xlsx (stub)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic requisition triage + temporary offer hold (comp bands review)

Evelyn — thanks for flagging. Agree with a short, surgical pause. Approve the 72-hour window for triage and comp-band review.

A few guardrails from finance:
- Target: reduce near-term headcount spend forecast by ~6–8% this quarter via pauses and reassignments where feasible.
- Exceptions limited to roles with signed offers or those directly tied to active revenue ops.

Lauren/Dev: please surface any offers already extended (signed or unsigned) and call out candidates in flight that need an exception.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering Operations

Recommendation: allow a very narrow exception to finalize and send the PDF offer to Priya (RQ-4938) if comp band check completes and finance signs off. Hold everything else. I've attached a short tracker (open_reqs_inventory_20260528.csv) exported from ATS.

Lauren Bennett
